# premation-engine — C1 viewport prototype (docs/VIEWPORT_ROUTE.md).
#
# Renders an animated scene with Dawn (native WebGPU) using WGSL taken verbatim
# from packages/renderer (shaders/renderer_wgsl.hpp, generated by
# shaders/extract.mjs), and hands frames to the Electron prototype host in
# proto-host/ by one of three routes:
#   --route A   offscreen render + readback, frames streamed over stdout
#   --route B   WS_CHILD window inside the Electron window, Dawn swapchain
#   --route C   D3D11 shared NT-handle textures → Electron >= 40 sharedTexture
#   --route bench   render only, no transport (GPU ceiling)
#
# Only built with MOTION_BUILD_ENGINE=ON, which needs the vcpkg `engine`
# feature (Dawn): the *-engine presets set both.

find_package(Dawn CONFIG REQUIRED)

add_executable(premation-engine
  src/main.cpp
  src/gpu.cpp
  src/scene.cpp
  src/wire.cpp
  src/os_ffi.cpp
)

if(WIN32)
  target_sources(premation-engine PRIVATE
    src/child_window_ffi.cpp
    src/shared_texture_ffi.cpp
  )
  target_link_libraries(premation-engine PRIVATE d3d11 dxgi user32 gdi32)
  target_compile_definitions(premation-engine PRIVATE WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN NOMINMAX UNICODE _UNICODE)
  # Dawn's D3D12 backend LoadLibrary()s DXC at device creation, so vcpkg's
  # applocal step (which follows import tables) never copies it.
  if(DEFINED VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR AND DEFINED VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET)
    set(_dxc_bin "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}/${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}/bin")
    add_custom_command(TARGET premation-engine POST_BUILD
      COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${_dxc_bin}/dxcompiler.dll" "${_dxc_bin}/dxil.dll"
              "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:premation-engine>"
      VERBATIM)
  endif()
endif()

target_include_directories(premation-engine PRIVATE
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/shaders
)
target_compile_features(premation-engine PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_link_libraries(premation-engine PRIVATE motion::options dawn::webgpu_dawn)
